items.title: Barry Kernfeld interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 16, 2020
items.q: can you do “Donna Lee” in every key? ... That’s a technical thing that is of just about zero interest to me.

ctx.x: Well for one thing it was the San Francisco Jazz Collective that — very accomplished, and perhaps my ears aren’t just modern enough for what they’re doing.

No there’s so many different things happening it’s really hard to say. There’s a huge infatuation with unusual meter. That’s like almost — so as jazz education, you know, formulated itself as a component of universities this idea of playing in all keys became popular. You know can you do “Donna Lee” in every key? And I think that has now morphed into can you do “Donna Lee” in any meter? So that’s a technical thing that is of just about zero interest to me. I don’t care about that. But there are so many different…
